summary: Sales CRM Phase 2 backend + frontend end-to-end tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering Team CRUD (create with duplicate 409, list with assigned_leads/won_deals stats & no password field, PUT update, PUT commission-rate endpoint, DELETE with 404 on unknown), Commissions (GET flat list, full assign→set won/commission_amount via team JWT→GET returns commission→PUT confirm→confirmed=true persisted, 404 on unknown lead), and auth 401 on both admin endpoints. Frontend: 'Team & Provisionen' tab found under 'Überblick' NAV group (data-testid nav-team), TeamManagement renders 4 KPI cards (Team Members / Total Commissions / Pending / Confirmed), New Member form opens with name/email/password/role fields, member creation → row visible with edit/delete data-testids, edit modal has name/role/commission fields + save, delete flow works (dialog auto-accepted). export-commissions-btn only shows when commissions exist (verified via count=0 when no commissions).
action_items: REVIEW MY FIX: I fixed a critical bug in /app/backend/routes/analytics.py::get_all_commissions() — the response was missing 'lead_id', which would have broken the frontend Confirm button in the All Commissions table (TeamManagement.jsx line 277: confirmCommission(c.lead_id || '') was passing empty string, causing 400 from confirm-commission endpoint). Added lead_id: str(l['_id']) to each entry. All 13 backend tests pass with this fix; without it, test_confirm_commission_full_flow fails at the lead_id assertion.
Consider also exposing 'lead_id' for the CSV export so downstream systems can reference the deal; currently CSV export omits it too.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamManagement.jsx line 84-99 exportCommissionsCSV omits lead_id/date columns and duplicates CSV logic already used elsewhere — extract to a shared csv util.

Frontend TeamManagement.jsx sends role='restricted' as default for new members (line 17) but backend defaults to 'member' — mismatch is minor (UI always sends explicit value) but worth aligning to avoid confusion.
TeamManagement fetches /admin/team-members and /admin/commissions on every mount without polling; consider a refresh button beyond confirm/create for stale data awareness.
TeamManagement.jsx catches all fetch errors silently with `catch {}` (line 31) — user has no feedback if list fails to load. Suggest surfacing a toast/error banner.
PUT /api/admin/team-members/{email} accepts an empty update body via HTTPException(400) but does not validate role is one of ['member','restricted']. A typo like role='admin' would be persisted.
GET /api/admin/commissions has an N+1 query pattern: for each team member it runs a leads.find(). Fine for small teams (<50) but should be refactored to a single $lookup aggregation as the org grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (nav, KPI, CRUD, edit modal, delete, export btn conditional all verified)

rca of the issue: Bug in /api/admin/commissions: for-loop that flattens leads across all team members constructed each entry dict without including the lead ObjectId. Frontend Confirm button (TeamManagement.jsx:277) does `confirmCommission(c.lead_id || '')` → hits /api/admin/leads//confirm-commission (double slash, empty id) → 400/404. Reproduction: 1) Assign a lead to a member, 2) Set property_value>0 and commission_amount>0 with status=won via team API, 3) Load /admin → Team & Provisionen → Confirm button in All Commissions table → nothing happens (or 400). Fix: added `lead_id: str(l['_id'])` to the appended dict.
